description: This Java source file defines a Spring Security configuration class that sets up security filters to permit all requests without authentication, disables CSRF, frames, basic auth, and form login, and explicitly allows access to Swagger UI, API docs, H2 console, static resources, and other endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: A configuration class enabling web security and defining a security filter chain to allow all requests, disable certain security features, and permit specific endpoints like Swagger UI and H2 console.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain for the application, configuring headers, CSRF, authorization rules, and disabling login methods.
